text:
Sam T: Quick question — thinking of shrinking the daily oncall handoff from 30m to 15m starting next Monday. Keep it tight: open incidents + blockers + any upcoming changes. Sound OK?
Lina M: 15m can work if we stick to a strict agenda. No deep troubleshooting in the call. :thumbsup:
Jorge R: Agree. Also propose we only escalate invites to the call for Sev2+ or if the pager is firing. Otherwise async notes in #incidents.
Anya P: Timezones: some folks in APAC — can we keep the meeting at the current slot (08:30 PT) or move? 08:30 PT is painful for EMEA some days.
Devon K: I'm +1 on 15m. For attendees: primary, secondary, oncall lead (for handoff), and owner(s) of any open Sev2/3s. Others can watch async.
Sam T: Proposed agenda (15m):
```
1) Quick roll call (30s)
2) Open incidents list + owner (6m)
3) Any active escalations / cross-team blockers (6m)
4) Immediate actions & who owns them (2m)
```
Sam T: We'll publish this template in the recurring calendar invite and pin it in the channel.
Lina M: Can infra-bot post the open incidents before the standup? That way people can glance quickly.
incident-bot: Automated update: open incidents: INC-342 (sev2) owner @Devon K; INC-351 (sev3) owner @Jorge R; INC-360 (sev4) scheduled maintenance. Last updated 1772103000.
Jorge R: Nice. If incident-bot posts ~10m before the meeting we can triage asynchronously and only join if needed.
Anya P: Calendar: I'll update the recurrence to 15m and add a short description + agenda link. Also add a note about who to ping for Sev2 escalation if not on the call.
Devon K: One ask — keep one 30m slot weekly for postmortem/learnings (Friday) so we don't lose context. 15m daily + 30m weekly sounds good.
Sam T: Agreed. I'll send the updated invite, add the agenda template, and set incident-bot to post 10m before. Can folks confirm they'll attend the new cadence?
Lina M: Confirmed.
Jorge R: Confirmed.
Anya P: Confirmed.
Devon K: Confirmed.
Sam T: Sweet. I'll also add a short first-message in the recurring invite with the checklist: latest runbook links, oncall rotation owner, and escalation matrix. :rocket:
Lina M: One more — holiday coverage next week (US holiday). Sam, can you add a note in the invite asking for volunteers to cover the holiday handoff?
Sam T: Will do. I'll follow up in the channel tomorrow with the new invite and a quick poll for holiday coverage. Thanks everyone.
